description: A vehicle USD on 4 ANCF FEM tires manoeuvring around a closed rocky corridor baked by third_party/newton-terrain-tool (--terrain: test_01_oval_easy / test_02_fourier_medium / test_03_fourier_hard / superjeep_track). run-examples.sh asks which vehicle USD to load (default: the Sherp; see 03_vehicle_ancf_tires); skid-steered vehicles get a pure-pursuit driver built with wheelbase = half track so its steer output is the turn command. Heightmap = rigid ANCF terrain contact on the full grid + a hidden block-mean hfield at --mujoco-terrain-cell (0.5 m) for the MuJoCo rigid parts (0.5 m block mean kept for this example; the vendored mujoco_warp collects up to MJ_MAXHFPRISM = 128 hfield prisms per geom, so the field example collides with the fine grid); route metadata (centerline, borders, spawn, checkpoints) drives the UI. The vehicle spawns at the origin heading +x and the terrain is shifted under it. Driver behind the TrackDriver interface (--driver manual | pure_pursuit); sliders take over when moved. Cruise speed 3 m/s = the speed above which the wheels leave the ground on this terrain: the centreline's rock component (4 m detrended) is 0.18 m (p95) at a 2.7 m dominant wavelength, v_hop = sqrt(g lam^2 / (4 pi^2 a)) = 3.2 m/s; a-lat 2.5 keeps the curvature cap on. max-wheel-speed null = the vehicle asset's rated top speed (Sherp 12.3 rad/s = 40 km/h); the wheel-speed ramp is capped at the traction limit mu g / r_roll. (9 m/s with a-lat 0 ran the tracker flat out and had the car airborne between rocks.) kn / kd / pcg-iters null = tire asset recommendation.
